suggestion.topic: Python AsyncIO vs Threading: When to Stop Blocking
suggestion.rationale: Developers continually confuse I/O bound concurrency with CPU bound parallelism, leading to broken GIL assumptions and unresponsive APIs. Demystifying this in a 3-minute vertical Short captures high-intent search traffic.
suggestion.hook_angle: Stop adding threads to your Python app hoping it gets faster—here is why your event loop is actually choking.
